# Testdata fixtures

Generated by `NEKODROID_WRITE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test --lib write_fixtures_to_testdata`:

- `hello_println.dex` — minimal DEX that prints via HLE
- `hello.apk` — ZIP with `classes.dex` + text `AndroidManifest.xml`
- `bad.apk` — corrupt bytes for error-path tests

A normal `cargo test` checks the committed bytes and does not rewrite them. Set `NEKODROID_WRITE_FIXTURES=1` to regenerate. Prefer not hand-editing the binaries.
